name: Nike Cross Regionals Heartland
where: Sioux Falls, SD · Yankton Trail Park
headline: Nike Cross Regionals Heartland
summary: Final: Ruby Ihmels won the girls race in a course-record 16:23.6, almost 20 seconds ahead of Ava Claasen (16:43.0), and Harrisburg (132) earned a team spot at Nike Cross Nationals. Keegan Decker won the boys race by 0.3 seconds over Jack Crossland in 14:42.5, and Sioux Falls Lincoln/Washington (165) earned an NXN team spot.
